hook.name: StrategyPunkHook
hook.description: Hook for a CryptoPunks liquidity strategy that restricts pool initialization and liquidity provision to an authorized vault contract. Charges a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95%, decreasing by 100 bips per 5 blocks, flooring at 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee, collecting fees via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributing 80% to the strategy vault and 20% to a fee address. Non-ETH fees are converted to ETH via a nested swap.
